If $\delta_1$ is a \Log{N1c}-!!{proof} (or \Log{N1i}-!!{proof})
of~$!A$ from open assumption~$!B^x$, and $\delta_2$ is a
\Log{N1c}-!!{proof} (\Log{N1i}-!!{proof}) of~$!B$, then
$\Subst{\delta_1}{\delta_2}{!B^x}$ is the result of replacing every
undischarged occurrence of~$!B^x$ in~$\delta_1$ by~$\delta_2$.
